meta_title: Crypto payments for online marketplaces & platforms · Dynopay
meta_description: Accept crypto payments on your marketplace or platform. Non-custodial, 15+ cryptocurrencies, from 1.5% fees. No chargebacks. Start in 10 minutes with Dynopay.
h1: Crypto payments for online marketplaces & platforms that keep you in control
subheading: Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet. Eliminate chargebacks, reduce payment friction, and pay sellers globally.
intro_paragraph: Online marketplaces and platforms face constant chargeback disputes, cross-border payout headaches, and payment processor restrictions on digital goods. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto commerce platform that sends funds directly to your wallet—no intermediary holding your money. You get payment links, hosted checkout, full API integration, and automatic fee-tier scaling from 1.5% down to 0.5% based on volume. Your sellers and users can receive crypto payouts in minutes, anywhere in the world, with zero chargeback risk.

features.title: Direct wallet settlements, always
features.description: Funds arrive in your own wallet for every transaction. Dynopay never takes custody, so you control liquidity, timing, and compliance. No waiting for batch payouts or intermediary approvals.

features.title: Zero chargeback exposure
features.description: Crypto transactions are final. Eliminate fraud disputes, friendly fraud, and chargeback fees that erode margins on digital goods, subscriptions, and high-ticket marketplace sales.

features.title: Pay international sellers in minutes
features.description: Distribute earnings to freelancers, vendors, and creators worldwide in crypto. No wire delays, no correspondent banking fees. They choose their preferred wallet and asset.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and create your company profile in under three minutes.
Add one payout wallet address for the cryptocurrency you want to receive as settlement.
Generate a payment link, embed the checkout widget, or integrate via REST API and start accepting payments.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can my marketplace accept with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, USDT on Ethereum, Tron, and Polygon, USDC, RLUSD, Solana, XRP, TRX, Bitcoin Cash, and Polygon (MATIC). All settlements go directly to your wallet.

faqs.question: What are Dynopay's fees for processing crypto payments on a platform?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop automatically to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges. Your first payment is completely free.

faqs.question: How do I pay out sellers or creators on my marketplace in crypto?
faqs.answer: Each seller or creator provides their own wallet address. You can send crypto directly from your treasury wallet, or integrate Dynopay's API to automate payouts.

faqs.question: Does Dynopay hold funds at any point during a transaction?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay is non-custodial. Every payment goes directly from the buyer's wallet to your specified payout wallet. You maintain full custody and control over funds at all times, with no intermediary lock-up.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto on my platform?
faqs.answer: Onboarding takes under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add your company details, specify one payout wallet, and generate a payment link or integrate the checkout. You can go live the same day.

cta_headline: Start accepting crypto payments in 10 minutes
cta_body: Your first payment is fee-free. No setup cost, no monthly fees, and funds settle directly to your wallet.
